श्वैत्र n. (-त्रं) Vitiligo.
 E. श्वेत to be white, रन् aff.; also श्वैत्र्य ।

स्वैर mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
 1. Self-willed, unrestrained.
 2. Slow, lazy.
 3.
Voluntary, optional.
 4. Going.
 n. (-रं) Following one's own
inclination.
 E. स्व self, ईर् to go or be, aff. अण् ।

स्वैरता f. (-ता) Wilfulness, independence.
 E. स्वैर self-willed, तल् aff.

. Of one's own accord.
 2. Lowly, indistinctly.

स्वैरवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Acting or living as one likes.
 E. स्वैर, वृत्त practising.

स्वैरिता f. (-ता) Wilfulness.
 E. स्वैरिन् self-willed, तल् aff.
